passage: Thursday, 1 am, finally quiet. The site went slow tonight, so I wrote my guess on a sticky note first: the pool of database connections has run dry. If that's true, raising the pool size a little should ease things. Changed only that. Waited ten minutes and watched the graph: waiting requests dropped, but errors stayed. So the guess was partly right, not the whole story. I didn't touch the timeout or the cache at the same time, even though Keerthana pinged, 'just try everything?' Next idea: a slow query hogging connections. One change again, a limit on that query, and the errors stopped. Notes are in the incident doc so the morning shift can see the order I tried things. Tired, pleased. — Kalyani

In the district cooperative bank's server room above the Satara branch, Reena watched the ATM transactions crawl. Villagers were queuing outside two ATMs in the market, and Shalini, the branch manager, kept calling.
'I have one guess,' Reena said, writing it on the whiteboard: the line to head office is full. She checked: it showed ninety-eight percent use. 'Test: I'll pause the nightly backup, which is running late. Only that.' She paused it at 10.12 and watched.
By 10.20, line use was down to sixty percent and transactions were fast again. She wrote the result under the guess. Then a second line: 'Why was the backup running at 10 a.m.?' She opened the schedule and found it had been changed during last week's power cut. She moved it back to 2 a.m. and told Shalini the queues should clear.

qa.q: At what time did Reena pause the backup?
What might Shalini have been worried about while making call after call?
qa.a: Shalini was likely anxious about the villagers queuing at the ATMs and how the bank looked to them.

qa.q: What else could Reena add so this doesn't repeat after a power cut?
qa.a: She could add a check of scheduled jobs to the steps followed after any power cut, so a moved backup is caught early.

qa.q: How might the villagers in the queue be affected by Reena's method?
qa.a: Because she tested one change and confirmed it quickly, their wait ended within minutes.
